item.title: Oscar Nominee Wagner Moura Can’t Help But Speak His Mind
item.description: The Brazilian star of The Secret Agent on politics, a World Cup win vs. an Oscar win, and his greatest fear: “When facts don’t matter—when people start to live in different mental worlds, in different realities—then how can you build a bridge?”

item.title: Jafar Panahi Explains How He Risked Everything to Create It Was Just an Accident
item.description: In the next installment of Vanity Fair’s What Is Cinema? series, Iranian filmmaker Jafar Panahi reflects on the misfortunes that almost ruined his movie—and his career.

item.title: Queen Máxima and Princess Amalia of the Netherlands Stylishly Land at the Winter Olympics 2026
item.description: King William, Máxima and the Crown Princess wear patriotic looks to cheer on Dutch competitors at the Winter Olympics 2026.

item.title: FBI Releases Chilling Security Camera Images Related to Nancy Guthrie Kidnapping
item.description: The Pima County Sheriff’s Department and FBI released six photos and three videos from surveillance cameras at Nancy Guthrie's home, recovered “from residual data located in backend systems” after “working closely with our private sector partners.”

item.title: King Charles Has “Profound Concern” About Allegations Against Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor That “Continue to Come to Light”
item.description: As more is revealed from the latest release of files related to Jeffrey Epstein, Buckingham Palace is “ready to support” any formal investigation concerning Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor.

item.title: All the Cool Girls Are Spending on Jeans
item.description: Quiet-luxury mainstay designer Nili Lotan just opened a jeans-only store in Tribeca. She’s not the only one betting on high-end denim.

item.title: Megyn Kelly Melts Down Over Bad Bunny: The Super Bowl Shouldn’t Be “Spanish” or “Muslim”
item.description: “That kind of football is ours,” the conservative pundit snarled in conversation with Piers Morgan, adding that the Super Bowl halftime show shouldn’t be “anything other than good old-fashioned American apple pie.”

item.title: Revisiting the Iconic Fashion of Caroline Bouvier Kennedy's Wedding
item.description: The 1986 Cape Cod wedding was a stylish spectacle sealing the Kennedy family's place as American royals.

item.title: There’s New Blood in the Old-Money Upper East Side Gallery Scene
item.description: Mnuchin Gallery is closing. Gagosian Gallery is moving. Change is afoot uptown—and younger galleries are here to seize the moment.
